hero.eyebrow: Bat Trang · a seven-hundred-year pottery village
hero.title: Every piece of pottery carries the seal of its maker.
hero.lead: vCraft takes you into the workshops of the craft village's households. Watch them work, scan the seal under a piece to see every step it went through, then order straight from the maker.

day.title: A day in Bat Trang
day.lead: From kneading clay to opening the kiln, six steps that every piece goes through. The photos are general pictures of each step, not photos of any particular piece. Swipe sideways to follow each one.

clay.name: Kneading
clay.text: The clay is filtered, rested and kneaded until every air bubble is gone.

throw.name: Throwing
throw.text: The clay goes on the wheel and the maker's hands pull it into shape.

dry.name: Drying
dry.text: It dries evenly in the shade so it won't crack in the kiln.

paint.name: Painting
paint.text: Patterns are brushed on by hand with blue underglaze.

glaze.name: Glazing
glaze.text: How thick the glaze goes on decides the shine and the shade of blue.

fire.name: Firing
fire.text: The kiln climbs past 1,200°C. Only when it opens do you see how the glaze turned out.

finish.name: Out of the kiln
finish.text: Each piece is checked one by one and sealed underneath before it leaves the workshop.

strategy.label: Automatic split proposal
strategy.hint: Pick a strategy to fill the board below. You can still edit every household by hand before sending.

CAPACITY.name: By capacity
CAPACITY.about: Shares in proportion to each household's capacity; leftover units go to the largest remainders.

CHEAPEST.name: Lowest price first
CHEAPEST.about: The household with the lowest unit price takes its maximum first, then the next one.

BALANCED.name: Balanced
BALANCED.about: Equal shares; a household that reaches its maximum leaves the rest to the others.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: What personal information you give vCraft, what it is used for, who can see it and how you stay in control of it. This page is kept short so it reads well on a phone.

controller.title: Who handles your data
controller.text: vCraft is a platform for managing one traditional craft village, operated by the village Management Board. The Management Board decides why and how personal data is processed on the platform.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.text: Only what each feature you use needs:

items.account: Account: email, full name and role. Your password is hashed and stored by Supabase Auth; vCraft cannot read it.
items.household: Artisan household registration: the representative's details, citizen ID number, photos of documents (ID card, proof of residence), workshop address and location, workshop photos.
items.quote: Quotation requests: order details, budget, delivery address and contact details linked to your account.
items.usage: Notifications, email preferences, the consents you gave (what, which policy version, when) and the audit trail of administrative actions.
items.technical: Technical data: IP addresses are stored only as salted hashes; system logs contain no passwords, tokens or ID numbers.

purpose.title: What we use it for
purpose.text: To create and protect your account; to verify and approve artisan households; to send, receive and coordinate quotation requests, quotations and orders; to send the notifications you chose; and to prevent fraud and keep the system safe. We do not sell your data and do not use it for advertising.

basis.title: Basis: your consent
basis.text: We process personal data on the basis of your consent, in line with Vietnam's Decree 13/2023/ND-CP on personal data protection. You give it by ticking the confirmation box when you register, register a household or send a quotation request. You can withdraw consent at any time; withdrawing does not affect processing that already took place. Each consent is recorded: what you agreed to, under which version of the policy, and when.

items.documents: Identity document photos sit in a private store; only administrators can open them, through a signed link valid for 5 minutes. The ID number is encrypted at field level: you only ever see it masked, an administrator sees the full number only by asking for it while reviewing the application, and every such view is written to the audit log.
items.quote: A quotation request is visible only to the invited households or, if you ask the Management Board to coordinate it, to the Management Board. One household's quote is never shown to another.
items.hosting: Infrastructure providers (Supabase for authentication, the database and file storage; an email delivery service) process data on our behalf.
items.public: The public information of an approved household (household name, story, products, showroom location) is visible to everyone.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.text: While your account is active. When you delete your account yourself on the Account page, your email, name, consents, notifications, email choices and every file you uploaded (identity papers included) are deleted, and the household profile, workshops, makers and news are taken down. Orders, quotations and the production journal of products are kept without your name, because other people rely on those records; delivery addresses on past requests are erased. An account with an order in progress cannot be deleted until the order is finished or the Management Board cancels it. Sign-in history is kept for 12 months and QR scan records for 24 months, then deleted automatically.

security.title: How we protect it
security.text: Data travels over HTTPS. Sessions use secure cookies, document photos live in a private store, ID numbers are encrypted with AES-256-GCM, and every access is checked against ownership.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: We use only the cookies needed for your session and the interface language, and no advertising cookies. The sign-in and registration forms may load Cloudflare Turnstile to block automation.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You have the right to know, access, correct, download, restrict, object to, withdraw consent for and request deletion of your personal data, and to lodge a complaint. You can correct your details yourself in Account and Studio, download all of your data and delete your account yourself on <account>the Account page</account>. For anything else, or when you cannot delete yet (for example an order is in progress), send a request to the Management Board through <contact>the village Management Board's contact channel</contact>.

changes.title: When the policy changes
changes.text: We update this page and show the date at the top. Important changes are announced inside the system.

consent.label: I have read the <link>Privacy policy</link> and agree that vCraft processes {purpose}.
consent.required: Agree to the Privacy policy to continue.

account.title: Your data
account.lead: vCraft only keeps what you entered. You can correct, download or delete it right here.

download.title: Download your data
download.text: A JSON file with your account, your household or quotation requests, notifications, consents and links to the files you uploaded. Links to identity papers expire after 5 minutes.
download.failed: Your data could not be downloaded. Try again in a few minutes.

consents.title: Withdraw consent
consents.text: You can withdraw each consent at any time. Withdrawing does not affect data processed before, and it does not delete data already stored; to delete your data, delete your account below. You can consent again when you need the feature.
consents.signUpNote: Consent given at sign-up is the basis for having an account, so it cannot be withdrawn on its own; to withdraw it, delete your account below.
consents.none: You have no active consent to withdraw.
consents.loadFailed: Your consents could not be loaded. Try again in a few minutes.

ID_DOCUMENT.title: Identity papers and citizen ID number
ID_DOCUMENT.effect: After withdrawing: you cannot upload more papers or set or change your ID number. Papers and the number already stored stay until you delete your account.

RFQ_CONTACT.title: Delivery address and contact details in quotation requests
RFQ_CONTACT.effect: After withdrawing: you cannot send new quotation requests with a delivery address and contact details.

MAKER_PROFILE.title: Showing a maker's name and role
MAKER_PROFILE.effect: After withdrawing: you cannot add or edit makers shown publicly on the household page.

consents.failed: The consent could not be withdrawn and nothing was changed. Try again in a few minutes.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.text: Deleting your account is permanent and cannot be undone.
delete.removed: We delete: your email and name, your consents, notifications, email choices and every file you uploaded (identity papers included). If you represent a household, its profile, workshops, makers and news are taken down too. Draft quotation requests are removed and open ones are cancelled.
delete.kept: We keep, no longer linked to your name: orders, quotations and the production journal of products, because other people rely on those records. Delivery addresses on past requests are erased.
delete.typeLabel: Type the account email to confirm
delete.mismatch: That is not the email of this account.
delete.blockedOrders: You have an order in progress, so the account cannot be deleted yet. Finish or cancel the order, or ask the Management Board to cancel it, then try again.
delete.blockedAdmin: Administrator accounts cannot delete themselves here. Ask another administrator.
delete.failed: The account could not be deleted and nothing was changed. Try again in a few minutes.

thoughts: Bát Tràng has made pottery since the 1300s…
Blue glaze is painted with cobalt oxide…
Old kilns burned pine wood…
Crackle glaze cracks as it cools…
Bát Tràng white clay is very fine…
Porcelain fires at about 1,300 °C…
One vase passes through many hands…
Ash glaze is made from wood ash…
The pottery market opens every day…
Throwing on the wheel needs steady hands…
Pieces dry before they are fired…
Brown glaze is the village's oldest…
Lotus and chrysanthemum motifs are common…
Gas kilns keep the heat even…
Relief decoration is shaped by hand…
Bát Tràng sits on the Red River…
Clay is soaked and sieved many times…
Hand painting a vase takes hours…
The craft passes down generations…
Ivory glaze looks soft as jade…
Stacking a kiln is an art…
Bisque ware has no glaze yet…
Plaster moulds make batches possible…
The fire decides the final glaze colour…
Each vCraft piece has its own QR code…
Money jars are a Lunar New Year favourite…
Teapots and cups are a classic…
Pieces that crack in the kiln are discarded…
Masters can throw vases a metre tall…
Fox is rummaging through the shelves…
